feature.label: Bio7 GDAL (FFM)
feature.description: GDAL for Java: the GDAL library of an installation (conda, Homebrew, the packages of Linux, QGIS, OSGeo4W) called with the Foreign Function and Memory API (Java 22+): raster and vector formats, coordinate systems and the tools of GDAL (translate, warp, ogr2ogr). No JNI library, no compiled code.
